notes: Pre-design print plan for the watch-capture cradle only. Charge-interface geometry (G-09) is BLOCKED and has no candidate predicate this revision by design -- it is intentionally absent from edges/support_rules below, not an omission.

upstream_gate_flag.action_required: metrologist/orchestrator to close REFERENCE_OVERLAY_REVIEW before this plan's candidate is treated as final, or explicitly accept the risk of proceeding on DRAFT metrology

geometry_rules.trigger: pocket sidewall height reaches band-exit Z along D3_BAND_AXIS
